turns.title: Review Q4 cart recovery & reactivation launch timing given inventory recovery
turns.description:
Customer paused new campaigns on 9/18 until Q4 inventory recovery. Meanwhile, abandoned carts have grown to 1,623 (30d) and 3,100 lapsed customers present reactivation opportunity. Current replenishment performing at 7.2 ROAS.

Action: Connect with customer to confirm Q4 inventory timeline and whether to prepare cart recovery + reactivation campaigns for launch when they're ready to scale. Both opportunities are material and data is clean.

recommendations.headline: Cart recovery & reactivation opportunities blocked by inventory constraint; review Q4 timing
recommendations.rationale: 1,623 abandoned carts in last 30 days (doubled from prior period) and 3,100 lapsed customers represent material expansion opportunities. Current replenishment campaigns perform at 7.2 ROAS with clean attribution. However, customer explicitly requested on 9/18 to pause any new campaigns until Q4 inventory recovery. With Q4 approaching, account manager should confirm inventory timeline and prepare cart recovery + reactivation campaigns for launch when customer is ready to scale.
recommendations.acknowledged_tension: Strong performance metrics and clear opportunity gaps support expansion, but explicit customer inventory constraint blocks new campaign launches until Q4
blockers: Customer-requested pause on new campaigns until Q4 inventory recovery

turns.notes: Investigated 1 account (Cinder Supply). Found material cart recovery and reactivation gaps with strong underlying performance (7.2 ROAS), but customer has explicit operational constraint blocking expansion until Q4. Recommend account manager proactively discuss Q4 launch timing rather than expand immediately. No other accounts required investigation today.
